notes.title: Update Notes for March 20th, 2024
notes.content:
Hey everyone, first I want to thank all of you who purchased Floomy.  I appreciated hearing about the fun experiences some of you had in overcoming the challenging gauntlet I created.

I also wanted to thank you for your patience.  Floomy is an early access title which means it’s still being developed and improved over time.  I know I haven’t updated the game since launch but that in no way means I haven’t been hard at work on it.  I am developing a big update, which will add an entirely new zone with new critters, challenges, and environment.

A zone is typically only 5 levels long but this one will actually be longer.  This particular zone, Crystal Quarry, will be tucked away as a secret for you to discover.  This zone is the most ambitious area in the game so I will need a bit more time to polish it.

However, I made many bug fixes and stability improvements as I continued working on new content.  As a result, I want players to benefit now from these improvements.   This build reflects the work I’ve done to make Floomy a more polished experience.

I don’t have all the bugfixes listed here but I figured I’d mention a handful that have been fixed:

[list]
[*] Pausing during a boss fight didn’t pause its projectiles.
[*] Pressing Jump on a pink ghost with frame-perfect-timing caused the player to fall through.
[*] Several overlooked memory leaks.
[*] Flag could cause the victory sound effect to play twice.
[*] A certain mega gem is impossible to obtain within a specific level.
[*] Certain compatibility issues caused some visual assets to be miscolored.
[/list]
